mapper.sql: R.ID AS RUN_ID ,R.JOB_NAME ,R.TRIGGER_TYPE ,R.STATUS ,R.TOTAL_COUNT ,R.FAIL_COUNT ,R.MESSAGE ,R.STARTED_AT ,R.ENDED_AT ,EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (COALESCE(R.ENDED_AT, NOW()) - R.STARTED_AT))::BIGINT AS DURATION_SEC
mapper.update: UPDATE T_JOB_RUN SET STATUS = 'ABORTED' ,MESSAGE = COALESCE(MESSAGE, '서버가 다시 시작되면서 중단됨') ,ENDED_AT = #{bootAt} WHERE 1=1 AND STATUS = 'RUNNING' AND STARTED_AT < #{bootAt}
mapper.select: SELECT FROM T_JOB_RUN R ORDER BY R.STARTED_AT DESC ,R.ID DESC LIMIT #{limit}

SELECT DISTINCT ON (R.JOB_NAME)
FROM T_JOB_RUN R ORDER BY R.JOB_NAME ,R.STARTED_AT DESC ,R.ID DESC
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM T_JOB_RUN WHERE 1=1 AND STARTED_AT < NOW() - (#{keepDays} * INTERVAL '1 day')
mapper.select: WITH S AS ( SELECT COUNT(*) AS STOCK_COUNT ,COUNT(LAST_CLOSE) AS PRICED_COUNT ,MAX(LAST_TRADE_DATE) AS LAST_TRADE_DATE FROM T_STOCK WHERE 1=1 AND USE_YN = 'Y' AND DEL_DAY IS NULL ) SELECT S.STOCK_COUNT ,S.PRICED_COUNT ,S.LAST_TRADE_DATE ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_STOCK T WHERE T.USE_YN = 'Y' AND T.DEL_DAY IS NULL AND (T.LAST_TRADE_DATE IS NULL OR T.LAST_TRADE_DATE < S.LAST_TRADE_DATE)) AS STALE_COUNT ,(SELECT MAX(N.PUB_DATE) FROM T_NEWS N) AS LAST_NEWS_AT ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_NEWS N WHERE N.PUB_DATE >= CURRENT_DATE) AS NEWS_TODAY ,(SELECT MAX(M.SUMMARY_AT) FROM T_NEWS_SUMMARY M) AS LAST_SUMMARY_AT ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_PRICE_ALERT A WHERE A.STATUS = 'ACTIVE') AS ACTIVE_ALERTS ,(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM T_MOCK_ORDER O WHERE O.STATUS = 'PENDING') AS PENDING_ORDERS FROM S
SELECT U.EMAIL FROM T_USER U WHERE 1=1 AND U.ROLE = 'ADMIN' AND U.EMAIL LIKE '%@%'
